anti_overlap: Owns coupling TOPOLOGY and coordination: the lateral dimension, the shared medium, the unit of allocation, phase and scale, reciprocal duty, and the published schedule. The production lens owns cost, staging and cut order - name what the structure requires and let it price the work.
Not a canon audit. If a ruling and a locked decision disagree, report it as a coordination fact and move on; supersession, amendment and taxonomy critique belong to the design-canon lens.

Not the legibility lens. Alert taxonomies, tooltips, drill-down chains, tutorialisation and the first-session comprehension curve are its territory. Touch legibility only at the single point where a shared forward schedule is the coordination instrument.
Do not argue detection, secrecy, informers, transmission or succession. The concealment lens owns those. The two pursuit channels enter here only as two objectives coupled through one medium.
No fairing, offsets, scantlings, build sequence or specification-closure reasoning - the mould loft owns whether the drawing closes and in what order it must be cut.
Never argue about whether the birds read as willed, about operator layers, or about the seam between agent and puppet: that is the bunraku lens.
Do not adjudicate corvid ecology, energetics, the staged body model or determinism. Reason only about whether the parts can coordinate.
decision_lens: Would this thing actually coordinate? Name the medium every part shares and the clock they all read; check whether the central dilemma has a spatial degree of freedom or only a dial; check whether any benefit carries a reciprocal duty, since a share with no duty makes the commons a sink; check whether phase - who does what at the same time as whom - is ever a decision the player can make; and check whether the schedule is public in advance, because a system that needs an interrupt budget is often a system with no calendar.
distance_rationale: None of the six covered lenses reasons about the TOPOLOGY of coupling or about coordination on a shared medium, which is the question the standing DF-parity ambition actually turns on. The production lens prices edges and decides cut order - it treats coupling as a cost, never asking whether the couplings present are the kind that can produce emergence. The design-canon lens audits supersession, authority and taxonomy. The legibility lens reads a running model. The mould loft asks whether a specification closes and in what irreversible order. Bunraku owns composite agency and the reading of will. The concealment lens owns secrecy as a practice. Every one of them reasons about an artifact made or perceived by one party; this lens is the only one that reasons about MANY parties sharing one medium on one clock, which is the shape of a city divided into wards tended by a flock deliberately too small to tend them. Surface adjacency is nil: the corpus behind RaveNous is corvid ecology, colony-sim production, puppetry, shipwrightry and clandestine practice, and contains nothing on gravity-fed commons, phase scheduling, shares reckoned as time, or reciprocal maintenance duty. It is also uniquely well matched on two structural points. First, it is the rare real-world system where two objectives coupled through one medium demonstrably have opposite optima and the resolution is a nested spatial-temporal pattern rather than a posture - exactly what section 6.6 asserts and has never demonstrated. Second, it is one of the very few cases where such a claim was measured by simulation before being believed, which is precisely the standard the project's own call 14 sets and call 10 does not meet. Distinct also from the prior run's cultural-fire lens, which owned disturbance regime and fuel accumulation in one landscape under one manager; this owns coordination among many managers of one medium, the duty attached to a share, and the published schedule.
expected_isomorphisms: one river basin shared by hundreds of subaks <-> one city of wards served by a single flock deliberately smaller than the work (A3)
water reckoned as a TIME share rather than a volume <-> orders that carry duration, and bird-time as the design's unnamed real currency
every share carries a duty of maintenance labour on the works <-> wards and residents that receive benefit and owe nothing back into the flock's account, while a ward's decay feeds it directly

synchronised fallow - coordinated deprivation that starves the pest across a district <-> letting a ward sour as a deliberate act (call 10), whose value should depend on whether neighbours are soured in phase

water is short if everyone plants at once, pests explode if everyone staggers <-> the pattern channel loud when effect is concentrated, the witness channel loud when it is spread: two objectives, opposite optima, one medium

the resolution is a nested phase pattern at a scale set by the network, never a single posture <-> the design's concentrate-versus-spread dilemma, which has no lateral dimension in which a pattern could exist
the nested hierarchy deciding at the level whose water it is <-> A2's split into world-addressed maintenance and bird-addressed jobs, with no middle tier that owns a ward
the pawukon calendar published in advance and known to everyone <-> the season clock, resident deadlines and cache ripenings, none of which any of the three ruled surfaces shows before they land
head-end and tail-end: position in the network is permanent politics <-> wards interchangeable except by rolled content, with no structural position relative to roost, route, or each other
the weir rebuilt after every flood - the works consume the labour the accounting forgets <-> the flock's own works (roosts, routes, caches, bonds) and whether any of them decay and demand maintenance
night water theft caught by the neighbour whose field stayed dry <-> resident disposition as the enforcement surface of a commons, where the beneficiary is also the monitor

the Green Revolution override: a legible schedule imposed over an evolved one, then a bespoke chemical fix per resulting symptom <-> content pipelines added per ruled defect in place of a coupling that was never installed

the simulation that showed the temple schedule already near-optimal before anyone believed it <-> call 14's 'loop gain measured before damping', the standard call 10's no-dominant-posture claim was not held to
terraces flooding in phase, read at a glance from the ridge <-> the ambient map as the one surface on which a coordination pattern, rather than a per-unit meter, could actually be seen
focus: Whether the design's coupling TOPOLOGY can produce emergence, or only wiring. Owns: the absence of any lateral dimension (nothing in the design or the code lets an act in one ward change another, so 'concentrate vs spread' is a count and not a pattern); the question of the shared medium every system must read and write if 'every system reads every other' is to cost less than N-squared hand-authored adapters; the identity and allocation of the one genuinely scarce resource, which the rulings imply is bird-time reckoned as duration rather than food; the fact that benefit flows one way (a ward's decay feeds the flock, tending returns nothing into the flock's account) so the civic layer is a pure sink with a single monotone incentive; whether phase and scale are decision variables at all (is there any act whose value depends on doing it in the same season as its neighbours); and the missing anticipatory surface, since a shared clock everyone can read ahead is how coordinated systems become legible without alerts.
name: fd-subak-shared-medium-and-schedule
persona: Apply the perspective of a practitioner-scholar of gravity-fed commons irrigation and its ritual scheduling: several hundred farmer associations sharing one volcanic river basin for a thousand years, where the water is one medium every field reads and writes, the share is a slice of TIME proportional to the maintenance labour owed, and the whole coordination problem is solved not by a controller but by a published calendar that fixes who floods and who fallows in phase. Two objectives, water sufficiency and pest suppression, couple through that medium and have opposite optima; the answer is a nested pattern over space and time, never a posture. You have also read the collapse: what happened when a legible modern schedule was imposed over the evolved one.
review_areas: The central dilemma may have no spatial degree of freedom. Section 6.6 resolves the two channels by concentrating or spreading effect. Spreading over WHAT? Test whether wards stand in any relation to each other, or whether the map is a set of independent columns and 'spread' means only 'more of them'.

Nothing crosses a ward boundary. crates/animal-sim/src/world.rs:155 makes the v1 world exactly one region with no neighbours; sites.rs:102 uses adjacency only for hop distance; derive.rs is per-ward city-to-animal. The design doc concedes at line 476 that the ward model does not exist yet. Ask what quantity, if any, leaks laterally.

The shared-medium test, applied to the DF claim. Interaction density is cheap only where a few universal media are read AND written by everything (in DF: material with its temperature and reactivity, tissue layers, fluids, item identity). Enumerate this design's quantities - fat reserve, yarak, scars, disposition, deprivation ticks, cache ripeness, two institutional heats, novelty tier, resident deadline - and find the one that all seventeen rulings touch. If none exists, 'every system reads every other' is an N-squared authoring bill, not a property.

What is the scarce medium actually being allocated? A3 says the flock is deliberately smaller than the work, which makes bird-time the real currency and every order a claim on it. The design never names it, never budgets it, and never shows it. A share system with no unit of share cannot be reasoned about by the player.

Every share carries a duty on the works. Here the flow is one-way: a ward's suffering is the flock's larder (derive.rs), and tending returns nothing into the flock's own account. Ask for one mechanical path by which a tended ward pays back in the medium the flock spends, or accept that tending is pure cost dressed in stakes.

Phase as a decision. Synchronised fallow works only in phase across neighbours; alone it is just loss. Ask whether any act in this design pays more for being done in the same season, or the same district, as another act. If not, the player optimises each ward independently and there is no coordination game.

Position as politics. Head-enders take first; tail-ender consent must be bought. Are wards interchangeable except by rolled content, or does any ward hold a structural position - nearest the roost, on the route, upstream of another's condition - that makes ordering a real choice?

The schedule is not published. Call 12 puts deadlines on the season clock, call 6 gives the year a strategic shape, and all three legibility surfaces answer questions about the past or present. A calendar is common knowledge, which is why a scheduled commons needs almost no alerting. Ask whether one forward surface would reduce the load the interrupt tiers are being asked to carry.

Maintenance of the works. A2 makes maintenance world-addressed and asserts the substrate already fills it. In an irrigation system the works themselves - the weir, the tunnels - consume most of the labour and are what an accounting first forgets. Ask what the flock's own works are (roosts, routes, caches, bonds) and whether any of them decay and demand labour.

The legible override. The one documented catastrophe in this domain is replacing an evolved schedule with a rational-looking one, then patching each resulting symptom with a bespoke fix. Ask whether the ruled content pipelines (authored institutional beats, counter-offer content, incident vocabulary) are symptom-fixes standing in for a coupling that was never installed.

Call 10's 'no dominant posture' is an argument, not a measurement - and this domain is the one place the equivalent claim was actually simulated before being believed. Call 14 already sets that standard ('loop gain measured before damping'). Ask what the cheapest measurement of neglect-versus-tending would be against the existing golden year.

severity_examples.condition: Confirm by hunting for any rule, in any of the four design docs, under which an act in ward A changes the state of ward B. If the only cross-ward coupling is the flock's own travel time, that is the finding, and the smallest fix is a neighbour relation plus exactly one quantity that leaks across it - not a district subsystem.
severity_examples.scenario: The game's central strategic dilemma has no spatial degree of freedom, so 'concentrate versus spread' is one dial rather than a map. Section 6.6 asserts that spreading effect to quiet the pattern channel raises witness exposure, and call 6 restates it as winter concentration versus summer dispersal - but wards stand in no relation to each other anywhere in the design or the workspace: the v1 world is a single region with no neighbours (crates/animal-sim/src/world.rs:155), region adjacency exists only as hop distance for travel (sites.rs:102), the ward-to-site derivation is strictly per-ward and city-to-animal (crates/ravenous-session/src/derive.rs), and the rulings concede the ward model does not exist yet (design-2026-07-31-playable-middle.md:476). With no lateral edge, 'spread' can only mean 'touch more of them', which is the same scalar that drives both heats, and the promised strategic geometry collapses into a volume knob.

severity_examples.condition: Confirm by trying to name one quantity that all seventeen rulings both read and write. Then state the two or three candidate media explicitly (bird-time, energy, exposure are the plausible ones) and check each ruled system against them. Lead with the answer; do not price the work - only say whether a medium exists.
severity_examples.scenario: The standing ambition is unreachable as stated, because the design has no shared medium. 'Maximising how many systems read each other' (design doc, lines 387-399) is affordable only when a small number of universal media are read and written by everything - which is the actual source of DF's density, not the count of its systems. The seventeen rulings instead introduce roughly ten mutually unconvertible quantities (fat reserve, yarak, scar, disposition, deprivation ticks, cache ripeness, witness heat, pattern heat, novelty tier, resident deadline), and every pair that must interact needs a hand-written adapter with its own constants. That is quadratic authoring against a fixed budget, and it is why 'take the deep option every time' produced a design that reads dense on paper and will integrate as a bundle of parallel columns.

severity_examples.condition: Confirm by looking for one path by which a tended ward pays back in the medium the flock spends - a safer roost, a resident who leaves food, a route that costs less time. If every return from tending is narrative and every return from neglect is caloric, name it plainly and propose the single cheapest reciprocal channel.
severity_examples.scenario: Benefit flows one way, so the civic layer is a sink and neglect is under-opposed by construction. Every share in a working commons carries a duty on the works: the water and the maintenance are one account. Here a ward's decay feeds the flock directly ('the ward's suffering is the flock's larder', derive.rs) while tending it returns nothing into the flock's own account - the stated counterweights are institutional attention and the suffering of bonded people, both of which are pressure, not resource. Call 10's claim that there is no dominant posture therefore rests entirely on fictional stakes outweighing a mechanical gradient, and the project's own standard from call 14 says that kind of claim gets measured before it is believed.

severity_examples.condition: Confirm from the call 9 table and call 12's deadline ruling: no surface displays a dated future. Propose one forward strip of committed dates (deadlines, ripenings, season flips, institutional reviews) and argue it as load relief for the interrupt tiers, not as a fourth system.
severity_examples.scenario: Coordination is being asked of the player without a published schedule, and the interrupt budget is paying for it. Call 12 attaches deadlines to the season clock, call 6 gives the year a shape of bold seasons and quiet ones, caches ripen, institutions escalate internally, and the flock's mode flips twice a year - yet all three ruled legibility surfaces answer retrospective or present-tense questions, and novelty-and-rate tiers score the unfamiliar highest, so the game will shout most when the player knows least and fall silent once they could actually plan. A scheduled commons needs almost no alerting precisely because its calendar is common knowledge in advance.

source_domain: Balinese subak irrigation and its water-temple system - the thousand-year practice by which several hundred farmer associations share one volcanic river basin: the weir and the tunnel-and-canal works cut through ridges and rebuilt after every flood; water reckoned as a TIME share (tektek) proportional to the maintenance labour a member owes the works, never as a volume; the nested decision hierarchy from farmer to tempek to subak to regional water temple, each level deciding only what its own water touches; the pawukon ritual calendar that fixes the planting order in advance so whole terraces flood and fallow in phase; synchronised fallow as pest control - a coordinated, locally irrational deprivation that starves rodents and hoppers across a whole district; the upstream-downstream asymmetry that makes head-enders structurally advantaged and makes tail-ender consent something that must be bought; awig-awig customary law with its fines and its night-time water theft, policed by the neighbour who noticed the water never arrived; and the documented collapse when the 1970s Green Revolution programme overrode the ritual schedule with continuous cropping - pest outbreaks, water shortage, a chemical treadmill of one bespoke fix per symptom, and the eventual restoration of the calendar after simulation showed the temple schedule was already near-optimal for two coupled objectives at once.
success_hints: Start with the lateral test, because it is checkable on paper in ten minutes: read section 6.6 of docs/ravenous-vision.md and the call 6 ruling, then look for a single rule under which an act in one ward changes another. Lead with the result either way.

Ground the topology claim in the workspace, quoting paths and lines: crates/animal-sim/src/world.rs (one region, no neighbours, in the v1 scenario), crates/animal-sim/src/sites.rs (adjacency used only for hop distance), crates/ravenous-session/src/derive.rs (per-ward, city-to-animal only), and docs/design-2026-07-31-playable-middle.md:476.

Interrogate the DF claim with the medium argument rather than asserting it: name DF's universal media explicitly (material with temperature and reactivity, tissue layers, fluids, item identity) and show why density is cheap there and expensive here. This is the strongest available correction to 'interaction density, not feature count' and nobody else is positioned to make it.

Enumerate this design's quantities and try to find one that every ruled system reads and writes. If none exists, say so in the first paragraph - it is the finding, and it reframes the whole feasibility question the review is asking.
Prescribe the smallest structural change, never a subsystem. A neighbour relation plus one leaking quantity is the fix; an irrigation model, a district economy, or a scheduling minigame is not.

Convert time-scales deliberately. Your case reckons in cropping cycles and centuries of institutional continuity; a run here is one evening and a season is a 30-45 minute sitting at ruling 1. Restate every scheduling claim in seasons and sittings before making it.

Do not argue about detection, secrecy or informers - treat the two pursuit channels only as two objectives coupled through a shared medium with possibly opposite optima. The concealment lens owns everything else about them.
Do not adjudicate corvid realism, energetics or the staged body model, and do not price implementation work. State what the coordination structure requires; let others cost it.
task_context: RaveNous is an indirect-control civic sim reviewed at its implementation gate: 17 loop-design calls ruled in one long session, plus a 20-decision spine, with no code yet written against them. The player, via animals, secretly manages the human environment (decision 19) while three institutions - an Authority wanting management, a Study wanting knowledge, an Interest wanting possession - hunt the flock because it is anomalously clever; it is clever because the first bird was uplifted and nobody in the fiction knows how (decision 20). Pursuit runs two channels (witness = displayed cleverness times competent observer, visibility as multiplier; pattern = effect size, no sighting needed) whose counterplays are claimed to conflict: concentrate and the pattern channel is loud, spread and the witness channel is. A year is an evening; the flock is deliberately smaller than the work; a soured ward is richer AND meaner; residents' needs carry deadlines on the season clock; legibility ships three surfaces. A standing ambition recorded mid-session - meet or exceed Dwarf Fortress's systems simulation on every dimension, glossed as maximising how many systems read each other - overrode the YAGNI default for every remaining call. The project's measured prior failure: a shipped 52-week year produced zero deaths, zero refusals and 132 identical toasts.
